thread.title: Here’s Apple’s Latest Move in Original Content

author: Sean Allen
title: Here’s Apple’s Latest Move in Original Content
text:
Must-Know Tech Sector Updates: Netflix, Hulu, Apple, and More PART 4 OF 8 Here’s Apple’s Latest Move in Original Content By Sean Allen | Jun 1, 2018 3:11 pm EDT Apple has been slowly building up its inventory of original shows
Apple’s ( AAPL ) content ambitions took off last year, and it earmarked $1 billion for original content. The company has been growing its content catalog since.
Apple claimed two top producers from Sony ( SNE ) last year and has also announced that it will be working on a reboot of the 1980s show Amazing Stories , which will be directed by none other than Steven Spielberg. Apple is also working on a drama series starring Jennifer Aniston and Reese Witherspoon, among other shows. Apple is likely to launch its original shows in March 2019. Interested in AAPL? AAPL Apple is creating a show on poet Emily Dickinson’s life
While Apple’s original content will have to compete with the likes of Netflix ( NFLX ), Amazon ( AMZN ) Prime Video, and Hulu, it has the deep pockets it requires to compete in the sector in the long term. However, how it will distribute its content is still a mystery.
According to a report by Deadline , Apple has made a straight-to-series order about 19th century poet Emily Dickinson. The 30-minute show will star Hailee Steinfeld.
The series is expected to be a comedic look into the poet’s life. It will be written and produced by Alena Smith, who is known for writing and producing Showtime’s The Affair and HBO’s The Newsroom . ["AAPL"],"ticker_names":["Apple Inc."]}
